status: DRAFT, not yet run: Aditya reviews before use
setting: Invented materials (alloys, coatings, compounds) studied in invented lab studies. Properties and test methods are real concepts; material names, labs and findings are invented.

words.paper_kind: a critical review in materials science
words.source_kinds: lab studies and the materials and earlier studies they assess

material.about: an invented material with a plausible code name (e.g. 'alloy TK-7', 'coating Veral-3')

study.about: an invented lab study named by lab and year (e.g. 'the Hollis Lab 2019 study')

reports_improvement.meaning: the study reports that the material improved the property it tested

reports_no_change.meaning: the study reports no clear change in the tested property for the material

reports_degradation.meaning: the study reports that the material worsened the tested property

fails_to_replicate.meaning: the study repeated an earlier study and did not get its result

questions.text: Which materials improved the tested property in {s}?
Which studies found that {o} improved the tested property, and which did not?

world_notes: Make 4-6 invented materials in 1-2 families and enough studies (years 2012-2025) that each paper has its own mix. A study may only fail to replicate an EARLIER study. Plant disagreements: two studies with opposite findings for the same material.
